name: How Many Times Can a Bellevue Hardwood Floor Be Refinished
title-tag: How Many Times Can Hardwood Be Refinished? Bellevue Guide
meta-description: Solid hardwood takes 4–6 full sandings; each removes ~1/32 inch. How to check what your Bellevue floor has left, and why recoats don’t count.
post-summary: November 20, 2026 · A solid ¾-inch floor carries about ¼ inch of sandable wood — enough for 4–6 refinishes over its life. How to check your floor’s remaining thickness at a heating vent, what spends the wood budget faster than it should, and why most Bellevue floors from the 80s–2000s red oak boom are nowhere near the limit.
